ae2ltpp.connector.missing_core: Install a packaged core before connecting machines.
ae2ltpp.connector.incompatible_target: This machine is not supported by the installed packaged core.
ae2ltpp.guide.title: AE2LT Packaged Pattern Provider Reborn
item.ae2ltpp.naturesaura_tree_ritual_pac: Nature's Aura Tree Ritual Packaged Core
ae2ltpp.resonant.bind_hint: Use on a machine to set the anchor; use on ports to bind. Sneak-use resets the anchor and layout.
ae2ltpp.resonant.select_hint: Sneak-scroll: select input slot; use in air: show selection
ae2ltpp.resonant.copy_hint: Use on a provider with a configured resonant core to copy its layout.
ae2ltpp.resonant.unbound: No layout: use on the machine anchor first.
ae2ltpp.resonant.machine_anchor: Choose a machine block as the anchor.
ae2ltpp.resonant.same_dimension: Bind ports in the source anchor dimension.
ae2ltpp.resonant.copied: Resonant layout copied, including its source anchor.
ae2ltpp.core_order.help: Choose a manufacturing or in-place upgrade recipe, encode a processing pattern and place it in the provider, then order from an ME terminal. The confirmation button shows the destination; hover for the provider location. In-place upgrades require one core per order. Include old cores as inputs to manufacture spares in bulk. Cancel in terminal crafting status.
ae2ltpp.jei.order_hint: Encode pattern → insert in provider → order in terminal
ae2ltpp.jei.upgrade: In-place upgrade · one at a time
ae2ltpp.jei.installed_core: Must be installed; consumed on completion, excluded from pattern inputs
ae2ltpp.jei.installed_core_short: Keep old core installed; encode only upgrade materials
ae2ltpp.jei.maid.title: Packaged Maid Altar
ae2ltpp.jei.maid.help: Each power point item yields 0.6 P. Requires a complete altar.
ae2ltpp.jei.maid.crafting_help: Consumes the pattern items and P. A fully formed altar is required.
ae2ltpp.gui.machine_recognition.normal_h: Place the provider directly against a supported machine.
ae2ltpp.gui.machine_recognition.wireless: Link a supported machine and keep its chunk loaded.
ae2ltpp.gui.machine_recognition.recipe_h: Dispatch also requires a matching core, recipe and machine operating conditions.
ae2ltpp.jei.supplied_core_short: Include old core as input; output goes to ME
ae2ltpp.terminal.install.help: Make %s cores. Install one on completion and store extras in ME. If the slot becomes occupied, store all results in ME. Cancel in terminal crafting status.
ae2ltpp.terminal.upgrade.help: Upgrade the installed %2$s. The old core stays installed until the upgrade step executes. Order one at a time; to make spares, use a pattern that includes the old core as input.
ae2ltpp.terminal.network.help: Make %s cores into ME storage, keeping the provider’s installed core.
ae2ltpp.terminal.busy.help: This provider has another core order or a result waiting for ME storage. Wait for completion, cancel in crafting status, or free storage space.
ae2ltpp.terminal.single_upgrade.help: An in-place upgrade needs a quantity of 1; this order requests %s. Go back to change the quantity, or use JEI’s make-spares recipe with old cores as inputs for batches.
ae2ltpp.terminal.missing_core.help: Install %2$s in the provider holding this pattern first. To supply old cores from ME, use JEI’s make-spares recipe instead.
ae2ltpp.gui.adapter_slot.help: Packaged core slot: insert a core manually or order one from a terminal for automatic installation. For upgrades, choose the JEI in-place upgrade recipe and put its pattern in this provider.
ae2ltpp.resonant.out_of_range: Input port must be within %s blocks of the main machine.
